note: All 50 are Haydn. Key finding: Hob. XIV keyboard divertimenti/concertini are harpsichord works (Henle HN 453: 'Klavier, eigentlich Cembalo'), so the ten in this chunk move to harpsichord/'other'; the same logic may apply to the early trios (the 1767 Hummel print 'Six sonates pour le clavecin' holds XV:37, C1, 39, 1, XIV:6, XIV:1), which I left as piano and flagged as doubt for owner ruling. BIS booklet (Huss) confirms one instrument to a part for the early divertimenti and gives the researcher's years (IMSLP/Wikipedia give Hoboken termini). Henle: XIV:7 and 9 predate 1764 and XIV:8 may be c. 1770, so the c. 1766 years are loose. Hob. XV:6-8 form one publisher's set (Artaria 'Oeuvre 40', IMSLP Op. 43); set left null as for XV:8.
